desc: The Fisher Cat is built for those who appreciate a sleek yet battle-ready aesthetic. Featuring a grey and tan Cerakote finish, this rifle combines rugged durability with a refined, tactical look. Outfitted with Magpul furniture, it delivers superior ergonomics, control and reliability for any shooting scenario. Whether you're on the range or adding to your collection, this AR stands out with its premium finish and rock-solid performance.
